business_summary.text: Swastika Infra Limited is a Power Transmission & Distribution (T&D) EPC company providing turnkey solutions across substations, underground cabling, and distribution lines with operations in 9 states.

guidance.statement: Overall yearly growth expected to be in line with the previous year
On full-year basis, EBITDA margins expected to remain in line with previous year

operating_notes.text: Order book stands at ₹1,420 Cr as of Sep-2026, comprising 85% Distribution, 8% Renewable, and 6% Transmission.
79% of the order book is funded by multilateral institutions like World Bank and ADB or central government.
Company entered Maharashtra during the year, expanding geographic footprint to 9 states.

holders.name: Shine Star Build Cap Pvt Ltd

timeline.summary: CRISIL reaffirmed Crisil BBB+/Stable and Crisil A2 ratings on Swastika Infra's ₹450 Cr bank facilities.
Swastika Infra Limited schedules Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings call on October 21, 2026, at 4:00 PM IST via Arihant Capital Markets Ltd.
H1FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹206.64 Cr, net profit ₹19.99 Cr.
Shipra Gandhi, Company Secretary, shared the audio recording of the Analysts/Investors Call on October 21, 2026, discussing unaudited Q2 & H1FY27 results via the company’s website.
Released Q2FY27 press release highlighting order book reaching ₹1,420 Cr (up 2.1x vs March 2026) and inflows of ~₹950 Cr.
